meta.defaultTitle: ON GROUND CAFE & FARM — Farm & Resort Experience near Pattaya
meta.description: Ride, explore, relax and eat at ON GROUND CAFE & FARM, a countryside farm and resort experience about 20 km from Pattaya, Thailand.

whyOdin.heading: A day in the countryside
whyOdin.lead: ON GROUND pairs open countryside with a slower pace — ride and explore by day, unwind by evening, and finish at a table that's part of the same place, not a separate attraction bolted on beside it.

howToBook.question: How do I book an experience?
howToBook.answer: Submit a booking request through our booking form. Our team confirms availability with you directly — a request isn't an automatic reservation.

whatToBring.question: What should I bring?
whatToBring.answer: Comfortable clothing and closed-toe shoes are recommended. Ask our team about any activity-specific requirements.

gettingThere.question: How do I get to ON GROUND?
